pesticide_advisory.recommendation_title: Pesticide Spray Advisory for Orange / Citrus (Huanglongbing (Citrus Greening))

chemical_pesticide.name: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL or Thiamethoxam 25% WG (Vector Control)
chemical_pesticide.dosage: 0.5 ml per liter of water (Imidacloprid) or 0.3 g/L (Thiamethoxam)

organic_alternative.name: High-Grade Horticultural Spray Oil (1.5%) + Neem Oil 3000 PPM
organic_alternative.dosage: 15 ml mineral oil + 4 ml neem oil per liter

pesticide_advisory.application_guide: Target new flush leaves where psyllids feed and lay eggs. Prune out symptomatic yellow shoots. Apply zinc & nutritional foliar sprays to boost tree resilience.
pesticide_advisory.safety_notes: Do not spray while citrus trees are in full bloom to protect honeybees.

nutrients_lacking.deficiency_cause: Pathogen infection in Orange breaks down cell membranes and accelerates foliar senescence, draining mobile potassium.
nutrients_lacking.symptoms: Leaf margin chlorosis, premature tip burn.
nutrients_lacking.dosage: 4.0 - 5.0 g per liter of water (foliar spray)

nutrients_lacking.deficiency_cause: Enzymatic cellular breakdown limits calcium integration into newly developing foliage.
nutrients_lacking.symptoms: Curling young leaves, weak leaf stems.

nutrient_analysis.nutrient_recovery_plan: Restore vascular transport by applying a water-soluble potassium and calcium foliar supplement to boost Orange cellular resilience.
nutrient_analysis.soil_advice: Check soil pH and ensure adequate drainage. Side-dress with well-decomposed organic manure.
